description: Concessioni di stoccaggio di gas naturale - agg. 2015 is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by servizi-gis.arpae.it. Areas in the Emilia-Romagna region where liquid and gaseous hydrocarbon storage activities are permitted. Data provided by the Ministry of Economic Development (web). Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Natural gas storage concessions - agg. 2015" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Suolo. The listing shows 2015-12-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
